title: Answer: human and animal subjects are derived from the cosmic one

statements.text: The consciousness of humans and animals is derived from cosmic consciousness: as aspects subsumed by it, as segments of it, or, on hybrid cosmopsychism, as strongly emergent subjects bearing experience inherited from it. Physical systems and their quantum behavior arise, on Shani and Keppler’s view, from resonance with the cosmic field.
